title: 第151章 棚户区
slug: 穿越民国获得每日签到系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

山田点了点头，“沈小姐的记性，让我刮目相看。不过，”

他话锋一转，声音陡然转冷，“你刚才说，你离开时保险柜已经锁上了。”

他拿起桌上的手枪，枪管在灯光下泛着幽冷的蓝光。

“可石井说，他离开时，保险柜根本没锁。”

山田把枪往前推了推，枪口抵住桌沿。

“现在，我再问你一遍。那张图，是不是你拿的？”

叶静姝看着那把枪，忽然笑了。

她伸出手，指尖轻轻碰了碰冰凉的枪管，然后抬起头。

“大佐，如果您觉得一把枪就能让我认罪，那您太小看宪兵队的翻译了。

您可以开枪，但开枪之后，您永远也找不到那张图。

因为真正的内鬼，此刻正坐在您的会议室里，看着您在这里浪费时间。”

山田的瞳孔猛地一缩。

他死死盯着叶静姝的眼睛。

那双眼睛里只有平静。

良久，山田把枪收了回去。

“你回去吧。”他挥了挥手，声音沙哑。

叶静姝站起来，把椅子推回桌下。她走到门口，忽然停下脚步，没有回头。

“大佐，”她的声音轻得像一阵风，“建议您查一查，石井大佐办公桌左上角的档案袋。

那个位置，只有左手拿文件的人才会顺手放下。石井大佐是右撇子。”

说完，她推开门，走了出去。

门外的宪兵侧身让开。

走廊里的光从窗户漏进来，照在她脸上。

她步伐平稳地走回了东厢房。

老周躺在床上，眼睛盯着天花板。

天花板上有一道裂缝，从灯座一直延伸到墙角。

小李凑过去，声音压得极低：“他们问你什么了？”

老周没睁眼。

“问接触过谁。”

“你怎么说的？”

“该说的说了，不该说的没说。”

“哪些不该说的？”

老周没回答。

他的嘴唇动了一下，又合上了。

右手食指还在摩挲裤缝，速度比刚才快了些。

参谋冷笑了一声，把杂志扔在床头，双手枕在脑后。

“别问了。明天还有第二轮。”

文书在被子里翻了个身，面朝墙，没有出声。

的肩膀还在微微发颤。

Yamada nodded, "Miss Shen's memory impresses me. However,"

He changed the subject and his voice suddenly turned cold, "You just said that the safe was locked when you left."

He picked up the pistol on the table, the barrel glowing with a cold blue light under the light.

"But Ishii said that when he left, the safe was not locked at all."

Yamada pushed the gun forward, pressing the muzzle against the edge of the table.

"Now, let me ask you again. Did you take that picture?"

Ye Jingshu looked at the gun and suddenly smiled.

She stretched out her hand, lightly touched the cold barrel of the gun with her fingertips, and then raised her head.

“Colonel, if you think a gun can make me confess, then you underestimate the military police interpreter.

You can shoot, but after you shoot, you'll never find the picture.

Because the real mole is sitting in your conference room right now, watching you waste time here."

Yamada's pupils shrank suddenly.

He stared into Ye Jingshu's eyes.

There was only peace in those eyes.

After a long time, Yamada put the gun back.

"Go back." He waved his hand, his voice hoarse.

Ye Jingshu stood up and pushed the chair back under the table.She walked to the door and suddenly stopped without looking back.

"Colonel," her voice was as light as a gust of wind, "I suggest you check the file bag in the upper left corner of Colonel Ishii's desk.

In that position, only the person holding the document in his left hand would put it down easily.Colonel Ishii is right-handed."

After saying that, she opened the door and walked out.

The military policeman outside the door stepped aside.

The light from the corridor filtered in through the window and shone on her face.

She walked back to the east wing with steady steps.

Lao Zhou was lying on the bed, staring at the ceiling.

There was a crack in the ceiling that ran from the lamp base to the corner of the wall.

Xiao Li leaned over and asked in a very low voice, "What did they ask you?"

Lao Zhou didn't open his eyes.

"Ask who you have contacted."

"What did you say?"

"What should be said has been said, but what should not be said has not been said."

"What shouldn't be said?"

Lao Zhou didn't answer.

His lips moved and closed again.

The index finger of his right hand was still rubbing the seam of his trousers, a little faster than before.

The staff officer sneered, threw the magazine on the bedside, and put his hands behind his head.

"Don't ask. There will be a second round tomorrow."

The clerk turned over in the quilt and faced the wall without making a sound.

His shoulders were still shaking slightly.
